title: Parsimonious Cook–Levin reduction to 4-CNF
claims: A measured map from bounded accepting witnesses of an arbitrary polynomial-time verifier to a CNF model set of the same cardinality, with clause width at most four.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against the pinned definitions.
